response.text:
Here are the deadlines coming up in October:

- **Fri 2 Oct 2026** – Return overdue library books to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149] [party:pty_d2ymm5s3htd0].
- **Wed 14 Oct 2026** – Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the contribution notice from Muster BKK, to be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg] [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3].
- **Wed 14 Oct 2026** – Cancel-by date for the FunkNetz Smart M mobile contract, to be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2] [party:pty_gjsv4q2d3ajw].
- **Wed 21 Oct 2026** – Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the tax assessment from Finanzamt Musterstadt, to be sent by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a] [party:pty_mcq97yavgqjy].

A couple of notes:
- The library deadline is high priority overdue-fee territory — the fee increases per day, and can eventually block your account, per the letter [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149].
- For the BKK contribution notice, an objection doesn't stop the assessed amount from being due in the meantime, per the letter [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- For the tax assessment, missing the objection deadline means it becomes final and can no longer be challenged, per the letter [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a].
